steps: A slider-crank turns spinning motion into back-and-forth motion, as in an engine or a pump.
Input: the crank turns. Its pin travels in a circle of radius 18 mm.
The connecting rod (62 mm) links the crank pin to the piston and pushes and pulls it.
The piston slides along a straight line. Its stroke is twice the crank radius: 36 mm per turn.
title: Slider-crank: rotation to back-and-forth
